score_scale: Each criterion scored 1-10. Overall = weighted mean. pass_threshold applies to the geometric-median aggregate across the panel.

criteria.name: Leaves the speech band alone
criteria.anchor: No lead melody under speech; dip 2-3 dB around 2-4 kHz where consonants live; voice fundamental sits roughly 85-255 Hz so keep the bass on plain roots (Veena background-music guide; Veena podcast-music guide; Podmuse: bed ~20-30 dB below the spoken voice).
criteria.evidence: The style prompt (melody claims under speech = defect), rms_1s_spread_db (bed energy steady), pct_energy_above_8khz.
criteria.guide: 10 = prompt claims no-melody bed, steady energy, no bright spikes. 7 = bed claimed, one unverifiable element. 4 = melody-with-hook claimed under speech. 1 = lead-vocal or hook-bearing track marketed as a bed.

criteria.name: Loopability: the seam is invisible
criteria.anchor: Loop without a seam when content runs longer than the music; end on a chord that leads back to the first (V or IV going home); no reverb/delay tail across the loop point (a tail crossing = click or double-hit); no crash on bar 1; export WAV not MP3 (MP3 padding breaks loops); game-assets/bed packs: loops must be seamless + click-free with stated BPM/key (Veena background-music; architecture §13 asset-pack packaging requirements).
criteria.evidence: measure.py first/last 1 s RMS: the file's rms_1s_min_db tail and head. A fade-out ending (rms_1s_min_db far below mean) fails a loop claim; a hard cut mid-phrase fails too. Cross-check duration_s against 4/4 bar math (bars = duration * BPM / 240).
criteria.guide: 10 = ending and start levels compatible with a loop (tail RMS within ~6 dB of head RMS, no fade-to-silence), duration divides into whole bars at the claimed BPM. 7 = levels compatible, bar math ambiguous. 4 = fade-out ending on a loop claim. 1 = obvious seam or truncated ending.

criteria.name: Energy holds — no drops, no builds, no sudden stops
criteria.anchor: Beds: no drops, no big builds, no sudden stops; changes happen gently at section boundaries (Veena; Podmuse: 'moderate arrangement changes — no sudden swells, drops, or impacts'). Target: rms_1s_spread under ~10 dB across the body; a bed longer than 15-30 s must survive repeated looping without attention spikes.
criteria.evidence: rms_1s_spread_db — a bed should show a tight band (spread roughly < 10 dB across 1s windows excluding intro/outro), silences_ge_1s (long silence = sudden stop).
criteria.guide: 10 = spread < 10 dB, no silences >= 1 s in the body. 7 = spread 10-15 dB or one marginal silence. 4 = spread 15-25 dB. 1 = dramatic dynamics on a bed claim.

criteria.name: Utility packaging: stems + instrumental + stated metadata
criteria.anchor: 82% of podcasts license stock themes (genres.yaml note); stems mandatory for sync + direct-licensing (genres.yaml defaults); loop packs must state BPM and key; stems time-aligned; consistent file naming (architecture §13).
criteria.evidence: Package contents (stems dir, metadata fields in the package manifest) — the panel scores the packaging when present; note 'packaging absent' when reviewing a bare master.
criteria.guide: 10 = stems + stated BPM/key + instrumental variant present. 7 = master + metadata, stems absent. 4 = bare master, no metadata. 1 = nothing verifiable.

criteria.name: Master hits the lane loudness target
criteria.anchor: Sync/direct-license targets -16 LUFS (pipeline gate_loudness spec). Beds sit under voice: the bed is mixed ~20-30 dB under the host, so the master itself masters to -16 for sync use.
criteria.guide: 10 = within +/-1 dB of -16. 7 = within +/-3 dB. 4 = 3-6 dB off. 1 = 6+ dB off.

reject_signals: lead melody/hook claimed under speech (fails the bed function)
fade-out or mid-phrase-cut ending on a loopability claim
spread > 25 dB rms_1s_spread (drop/build dynamics) on a bed claim
no stated BPM/key metadata for a loop product (asset-pack packaging requirement)

sources.title: How to Make Background Music for Videos and Podcasts
How to Make Podcast Music: Intros, Beds, Stings & Outros
Background Music for Podcasts: A Strategic Guide
Bed Head Music Pack Volume 1 (perfectly loopable creator packs)

notes: Market: podcast/creator stock themes (82% of podcasts license stock themes). Loop + stems are the product; a beautiful non-loopable bed is inventory, not product.
